'''Kelrodo-Ai''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with famous [[gelatin]] mines and known for its [[Water/Legends|water]]-sculptures. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], its [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] was [[Drom Guldi]].<ref name="Darksaber" />
